acceptance_criteria: Shared and project initialization guidance permits third-party Python libraries, requires reuse evaluation and approved isolated installation with manifests, while keeping the harness dependency-free
objective: Clarify dependency reuse and explicitly approved installation policy
decisions: Documentation maintenance: Python permits application libraries; keep the core harness dependency-free. Approval may be scoped in config/task plans; no resolver/installer added.
changes: Updated shared rules, README, configuration interview, initialization primer, workflow reference, builder/reviewer/tester roles and execution boundary guidance.
validation: Independent QC then existing harness regression suite; no new prose-mirroring tests.
